Set Project Version

Source: R/version.R
projr_version_set.Rd

Updates the Version field of DESCRIPTION when present. Otherwise, stores the project version in a root VERSION file. This is useful in cases where you need to increment the version manually, for example, if a collaborator has pushed changes and you want to manually set your version before merging.

Usage

projr_version_set(version, only_if_exists = TRUE)

Arguments

version

A character string specifying the version to set. It may include a development component (e.g., "1.2.3-dev") or just the stable version (e.g., "1.2.3").

only_if_exists

A logical flag indicating whether to update the VERSION file only if it already exists (TRUE) or to create it if it doesn't exist (FALSE). Defaults to TRUE.

Value

Invisibly returns TRUE if successful.
